statement.text: Let $(A_i)$ be a family of countably infinite sets such that $\lvert A_i\cap A_j\rvert eq 2$ for all $i eq j$. Find the smallest cardinal $C$ such that $\cup A_i$ can always be coloured with at most $C$ colours so that no $A_i$ is monochromatic.
